source.title: The brain's default network and its adaptive role in internal mentation

confidence_rationale: Establishes the END-STATE that ARC-090 says development compresses INTO: the default mode network is a set of interacting hubs and subsystems supporting 'internal mentation' -- self-reference, autobiographical memory, future simulation/prospection, and adaptive introspective thought -- the exact function list ARC-090 attributes to the mature internal DMN. This grounds the target of the developmental claim with mechanism/connectivity evidence. It does NOT itself test the developmental-externalisation thesis (that those functions first run externally in play), so it supports one half of ARC-090 (what the end-state is) and is silent on the other (the externalise->internalise trajectory), which is why it is paired with the Fair 2008 maturation entry.
failure_signatures: The review characterises the ADULT/mature default network; it makes no claim that DMN functions are developmentally PRECEDED by external play-based instantiation -- ARC-090's distinctive thesis is therefore unsupported by this paper alone (it grounds the end-state, not the precursor).

The fractionation into hubs/subsystems is partly inferential from functional-connectivity correlations; the mapping from 'DMN subsystem' to a discrete REE generative-modelling module is an architectural translation, not a one-to-one correspondence.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The default network -- midline and lateral cortical regions more active during rest/idle moments -- is organised into interacting hubs and subsystems that play a central role in 'internal mentation': spontaneous and deliberate introspective, self-referential, autobiographical-memory, and future-oriented (prospective) thought. These are adaptive functions, not mere task-negative idling.
mapping.ree_translation: Grounds the END-STATE in ARC-090: the mature internal DMN performs self-reference, autobiographical memory, future simulation, and narrative/counterfactual mentation. This is the same function set REE already owns as the internal-DMN end-state (ARC-014 safe imagination without commitment; MECH-029 reflective evaluation), and that ARC-090 asserts development compresses INTO. The hub/subsystem organisation also supports treating these as separable functions rather than one monolithic capacity.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The review is about the adult network and its functions; it neither supports nor tests ARC-090's distinctive developmental claim that those functions first run EXTERNALLY in play. It grounds the destination of the developmental ladder, not the ladder itself.
mapping.source_context: Synthesis of human structural/functional neuroimaging and the mind-wandering behavioural literature; adult populations.

confidence_components.notes: Authoritative, heavily-cited review by a leading DMN researcher; source quality high. Mapping fidelity moderate because it grounds only the end-state half of ARC-090. Transfer risk low for the function inventory (human neuroimaging -> REE internal-DMN end-state REE already commits to), higher only for the subsystem->module step.
